تتغافلوا (form VI)
# تَتَغَافَلُوا (tataḡāfalū) /ta.ta.ɣaː.fa.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَغَافَلَ (taḡāfala)
# تُتَغَافَلُوا (tutaḡāfalū) /tu.ta.ɣaː.fa.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَغَافَلَ (taḡāfala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
